device.description: Dual 12-bit 50-200 kSPS simultaneous-sampling differential SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial output
device.note: adc122s625.pdf (SNAS451A) p.1 connection diagram, p.2 pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.5 timing specifications, p.6 Figures 1-2 (single and continuous conversion), p.16-17 serial interface, p.17-18 data output and Table 2 (two's complement)

pages: p.1 (connection diagram), p.2 (pins), p.3 (operating ratings: VA 4.5-5.5 V, digital inputs 0 V to VA), p.5 (tEN 20 ns, tDA 26 ns, tDIS 20 ns max), p.6 (Figures 1-2: 4 zeros + ChA DB11-DB0, 4 zeros + ChB DB11-DB0), p.16-17 (serial interface), p.17-18 (two's complement, Table 2)
notModeled: differential analog inputs, simultaneous sampling of both channels and the external reference; the conversion is clocked by SCLK (12 SCLK cycles), not timed: both results are the 0 V code 0x000 at once
continuous conversion (N x 32 SCLKs per CS low, Figure 2) is approximated by repeating the 32-bit output pattern (idle "repeat")
SPI mode 3 chosen (DOUT changes on SCLK falling edges, valid on rising edges); the datasheet allows CS to fall with SCLK high or low (with SCLK low the CS fall counts as the first falling edge)
CS raised before the 16th falling edge aborts the conversion (DOUT to high impedance at CS rise is modeled); power-down while CS is high (no digital effect)
SCLK frequency limits (1.6-6.4 MHz) and tCSSU setup
variants: ADC122S655 (200-500 kSPS, SNAS445A) is the same pinout, frame and timing at a higher clock range (own spec); ADC122S706 (500 kSPS-1 MSPS) adds a VD supply and dual outputs in TSSOP-14
